description: This file contains FastAPI test cases utilizing pytest and TestClient to test the API endpoints related to nested models for offers, items, and images. It also includes fixtures that dynamically import modules based on Python versions.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that creates and returns a TestClient instance for the imported module's app, parameterized for different Python versions.

methods.name: test_post_all(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests posting a complete offer with nested items and images, expecting a successful response matching the input data.

methods.name: test_put_only_required(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests posting an offer with only required fields, verifying optional fields default to None or empty.

methods.name: test_put_empty_body(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests posting an empty body, expecting validation errors indicating missing required fields.

methods.name: test_put_missing_required_in_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests posting an offer with an item missing required fields, expecting validation errors.

methods.name: test_put_missing_required_in_images(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests posting an item with images missing required fields, checking for validation errors.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Retrieves and verifies the OpenAPI schema generated by FastAPI, ensuring it contains correct schema definitions for the nested models.
